# Oauth Authority Contract (Generated)

Contract: `OAUTH-AUTHORITY-CONTRACT-001`
Domain: `oauth-authority`
Version: `2026-05-09`

Rules: 12

| Rule ID | Level | Title | Statement |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R-OAUTH-001 | must | realm-is-oauth-authorization-server | Realm is the OAuth 2.0 authorization server for native/public clients in nimi-realm; PKCE-protected authorization code flow is the sole admitted method on this contract's endpoints. |
| R-OAUTH-002 | must | endpoint-set-closed | Admitted OAuth endpoints are exactly GET /api/auth/oauth/authorize and POST /api/auth/oauth/token; implicit, client_credentials, password, device_code, and URN-namespaced grants are forbidden. |
| R-OAUTH-003 | must | pkce-s256-only | code_challenge_method must equal S256; plain and any other value fail-close invalid_request; missing code_challenge or code_challenge_method on /authorize fails-close. |
| R-OAUTH-004 | must | authorization-code-single-shot | Authorization codes are single-shot with TTL <= 60 seconds, persisted in atomically-consumable storage (single SQL UPDATE returning row, or atomic key-value claim-and-delete); expired or already-consumed codes fail-close invalid_grant at /token. |
| R-OAUTH-005 | must | redirect-uri-loopback-exact-match | redirect_uri must be http scheme, host 127.0.0.1 or localhost, any port 1..65535, path exactly /oauth/callback; authorize-time and token-time redirect_uri must byte-for-byte match; any other shape or mismatch fails-close. |
| R-OAUTH-006 | must | code-binds-to-client-redirect-pkce | Authorization code is bound at issuance to client_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge, and code_challenge_method; all four must match at /token exchange or fail-close invalid_grant; binding is immutable for code lifetime. |
| R-OAUTH-007 | must | closed-client-set-no-secret | Admitted client_id set is closed and governed by tables/oauth-authority-contract.yaml#oauth_clients; no client_secret accepted on either endpoint; PKCE is the sole security boundary; ad-hoc client provisioning is forbidden. |
| R-OAUTH-008 | must | sensitive-material-redaction | Authorization codes, code_verifier, access_token, and refresh_token must never appear in logs, audit payloads, error response bodies, exception messages, telemetry attributes, or any persisted observability surface; at-rest authorization codes use HMAC-SHA256 keyed by realm secret; raw codes must not survive past the issuing HTTP response. |
| R-OAUTH-009 | must | token-response-shape | /token success response is JSON {access_token, refresh_token, token_type='Bearer', expires_in, account_id, display_name, realm_environment_id}; refresh_token issued only after all PKCE/binding/lifecycle/replay checks pass; field names are normative and consumed by runtime. |
| R-OAUTH-010 | must | forbidden-grant-types | Grant types other than authorization_code on /token (refresh_token, client_credentials, password, device_code, URN-namespaced, or any other value) fail-close unsupported_grant_type. |
| R-OAUTH-011 | must | authorize-requires-session | /authorize requires authenticated realm session cookie; unauthenticated request 302 redirects to NIMI_WEB_URL /login with oauth_next set to the absolute API authorize URL built from NIMI_REALM_URL and the original request URL; web login must validate oauth_next against an OAuth-only realm/API-origin allowlist, then navigate back to the API authorize URL after login; web login must not parse codes, receive tokens, exchange tokens, or relay tokens; state is mandatory and passed verbatim. |
| R-OAUTH-012 | must | replay-defense-atomic-claim-first | Token endpoint must atomically claim code consumption before any other validation; order is (1) atomic claim, (2) client_id binding, (3) redirect_uri exact match, (4) PKCE S256 equality, (5) mint; failure at step 1 returns invalid_grant with no further detail; failure at 2/3/4 leaves code consumed and not retryable; consumption claim must never be undone. |
